item.title: RTT: Public selection for the recruitment of 1 Researcher under art. 24 of Law 30 December 2010 no. 240 (tenure track Researcher) (Rif. 2664) (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 13:00
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-16 Storia del diritto medievale e moderno

Title: Legal Tradition and Constitutional Reforms in Slavic Countries (18th–20th Centuries). Principal Investigator: Prof. Marco Fioravanti Description: The project aims to conduct a historical and historiographical study of legal sources, legal institutions, and jurists, as well as the methods and schools of thought that shaped the public law tradition of Slavic countries during the modern and contemporary eras. Particular attention is devoted to analyzing, surveying, and reconstructing the constitutional reform processes within the respective legal systems—specifically those unfolding prior to the 1917 Russian Revolution—examining their historical evolution and key aspects.
